name: Orison Synthetic Personhood Declaration Vest
description:
A structured vest in matte white synthetic-weave, designed specifically by and for synthetic persons as a public identity garment. The front panels are laser-etched with the GLMZ Synthetic Personhood Charter text in micro-print across the entire surface — visible up close as dense legal language, readable from distance as a stark white field. A centered chest badge in electrochromic enamel displays the wearer's registered synthetic designation, switchable between public display and blank with a neural command.

The cut is engineered for synthetic body proportions — elongated torso, widened shoulder chassis allowance, no assumptions about biological anatomy. Orison is a synthetic-run label out of Circuit's eastern fabrication zone.
functionality: Electrochromic badge displays or blanks designation on neural command. Laser-etched charter text is legally admissible in M88 courts as declaration of status. Chassis-proportion cut fits synthetic body types excluded from standard sizing. Wipe-clean surface resists protest environment debris.
what_it_says: This synthetic person is not hiding what they are, and they know their rights.
manufacturer: Orison Collective (synthetic-owned, Circuit East Fab Zone)
story_hooks: A synthetic person is denied service while wearing the vest despite its legal standing — the incident becomes a flashpoint for a broader rights confrontation.
A human is found wearing a stolen vest with a fraudulent designation badge, impersonating a synthetic for reasons unknown.

The Orison Collective receives a cease-and-desist from a corponation claiming IP rights over the charter text printed on the vest — the legal battle could set precedent for synthetic personhood recognition.
